fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: Enable new positions; false exits existing positions.

fields.name: enter_apr
fields.doc: Annualised net edge required to enter.

fields.name: exit_apr
fields.doc: Annualised net edge below which an existing position exits.

fields.name: borrow_apr
fields.doc: Annual opportunity/borrow charge; the strategy never borrows spot itself.

fields.name: fee_horizon_ms
fields.doc: Horizon over which round-trip taker fees and crossing cost are amortised.

fields.name: entry_window_ms
fields.doc: Enter only within this interval before the next short-leg settlement.

fields.name: min_lead_ms
fields.doc: Minimum lead time for execution before settlement.

fields.name: funding_max_age_ms
fields.doc: Funding observation expiry; never applied to an unchanged healthy BBO.

fields.name: max_notional
fields.doc: Per-group, per-leg notional cap in valuation currency (1e-6).

fields.name: capital_fraction
fields.doc: Fraction of each wallet allocated, divided across groups sharing that venue.

fields.name: max_leverage_x100
fields.doc: Upper bound on actual exchange leverage, in hundredths.

fields.name: max_cross
fields.doc: IOC crossing allowance, also charged on both entry and exit in the signal.

fields.name: retry_ms
fields.doc: Evaluation timer and target retry interval, measured in engine time.

notes.name: CarryTarget
notes.doc: linked target requested; zero quantity exits

report.name: net_apr
report.doc: net annual edge at the latest target
